verdicts.reason: A is just the original banner shrunk into a thin strip in the middle of the tall canvas. More than 80% of it is dead grey space, and the quote and the 'G.M. ALLEN' text are too small to read, so there is no real resize at all. B restacks things sensibly (photo, then quote, then attribution) and the quote is readable, but it has clear flaws. The top bracket mark is blown up far larger than its partner. The attribution box is pushed off the quote's left edge and nearly touches the right edge. The small bottom mark floats on its own, and the bottom fifth is empty.
